blocks.text: Liloan shootout: Police vs 4 armed men, 1 wounded, 1 nabbed CEBU CITY, Philippines — A shootout between policemen and four armed men, believed to be guns-for-hire, resulted in the arrest of two armed men, one of whom was wounded by a gunshot wound to the body. Two of the suspected guns-for-hire men, however, managed to escape from the policemen during the firefight in Sitio Curva, Brgy. San Vicente, Liloan town, on Thursday afternoon, November 26, 2026.
